status: Source preview; awaiting approval for packaging
main_note_count: One for every saved concept; no copy or additional record is needed
subconcepts: Each contributes its own main note and additional items to itself and its explicit parent
legacy_main_note_copies: Exact main-note text copies remain saved but count once, including after renaming
palette: Blue, cyan, pale neutral, yellow, orange, red; linear interpolation without a green segment
count_spacing: Every integer tick uses the same horizontal increment, in all presets
saturation: Only color saturates; exact counts remain visible
parent_indicator: Neutral ring and child-count badge on every visible parent, collapsed or expanded
selection: Corner marks, distinct from the parent indicator
